### 1) `aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`
- Runs module-level candidates and selects the best-performing configuration(s) per your registry.
- Expected outcome: either a new module candidate becomes “PASS” and is eligible to replace parts of the champion, or everything remains below threshold.

### 2) `system_autopilot.py ...`
- Runs system-level candidates defined in `system_candidates.yaml` (end-to-end combos).
- Expected outcome: potentially a new end-to-end champion if something improves lockbox (especially important).

### 3) `aub_next_fix.py ...`
- Generates a concrete “next fixes” report in `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` based on recent failures/weak spots.
- Use this if the autopilots don’t yield improvements (or to prioritize targeted work).

## Quick sanity checks after running
- Confirm whether any candidate **improved lockbox_mean** vs **1.7925** (that’s usually the hardest-to-game metric).
- Check whether improvements are broad (mean) vs spiky (min only). A better **min** with worse **mean** can indicate brittleness.
